title: Google Translate
description: Open Google Translate's Live translate screen with the conversation's languages already set, through the googletranslate: link the app publishes for its own launcher shortcut. Google Translate reports nothing back, so the receipt says the screen was opened, never that anything was heard, translated, or spoken.
setup: Install Google Translate (com.google.android.apps.translate); this action pins its main activity and fails if the app is absent.
Let Google Translate use the microphone. It asks the first time Live translate runs, and EVA cannot grant it.
Download the languages inside Google Translate to translate them without a network connection.

tool.name: live_translate
tool.title: Start live translation
tool.description: Open Google Translate's Live translate screen, which keeps the microphone open, transcribes each side of a spoken conversation, and reads the translation aloud in the other language. Give languages as Google Translate's codes: en, es, fr, de, it, pt, pt-BR, nl, ru, uk, pl, tr, ar, he, hi, fa, th, vi, id, ja, ko, zh-CN, zh-TW. Use it when the user wants to talk with someone in another language, not to translate text EVA already has. A code Google Translate does not recognize is discarded and the app keeps whichever languages it last used. Opening the screen is all this reports; the microphone, the languages the app settles on, and every translation are unverified.

target_language.description: Google Translate code for the language to translate into, such as es, ja, or pt-BR.

source_language.description: Google Translate code for the language being spoken, such as en. Omit it, or pass auto, to let the app detect the speaker's language.

receipts.success: Live translate opened in Google Translate. Whether it is listening is not verified.
receipts.handlerMissing: Google Translate is not installed, or the installed version does not have the Live translate screen this link opens.
